translations.web: They said to him, “Please ask counsel of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.”
translations.bsb: Then they said to him, “Please inquire of God to determine whether we will have a successful journey.”
translations.kjv: And they said unto him, Ask counsel, we pray thee, of God, that we may know whether our way which we go shall be prosperous.
